---
title: "Supplementary Figure 6 : E. Coli Mapping"
output: html_notebook
---

R notebook for the reconstruction of Supplementary FIgure 6 of E. Coli and pks gene island mapping from unmapped reads
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
metagenomics_master<-read.csv('../Data/e_coli_pks_gene_mapping_outputs.csv')
```
print summaries from E. Coli mapping :
```{r}
print(paste0('Median mapped by KrakenUniq :', median(metagenomics_master$new_est_reads_braken)))
print(paste0('Lower CI mapped by KrakenUniq :', quantile(metagenomics_master$new_est_reads_braken,0.25)))
print(paste0('Lower CI mapped by KrakenUniq :', quantile(metagenomics_master$new_est_reads_braken,0.75)))
print(paste0('E coli identified by metaphlan in : n=', nrow(metagenomics_master[metagenomics_master$coverage_metaphlan>0,])))
```
construct plots for E. Coli mapping :
```{r}
png('~/krakenuniq_metaphlan.png',width=2400,height=1500, res=300)
ggplot(data=metagenomics_master, aes(x=estimated_number_of_reads_from_the_clade_metaphlan,y=new_est_reads_braken))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(x='Reads Mapped to E. Coli [Metaphlan]',y='Reads Mapped to E. Coli [KrakenUniq]')+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face='bold',size=14))+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12))
dev.off()
```

print summaries for pks mapping :
```{r}
print(paste0('Number of crypts with at least one gene mapped : n=', nrow(metagenomics_master[metagenomics_master$bowtie_detected_pks_genes>0,])))
```
```{r}
png('~/bowtie_lexicmap.png',width=2400,height=1800, res=300)
ggplot(data=metagenomics_master, aes(x=max_qcovGnm_lexicmap,y=bowtie_detected_pks_genes))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(x='Proportion of E. Coli IHE3034 Genome Mapped [Lexicmap]',y='Number of genes in the pks cluster mapped [Bowtie2]')+
  geom_hline(yintercept=8, linetype='dashed')+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face='bold',size=14))+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12))
dev.off()
```
